description: Perform Bader charge analysis on bulk rutile TiO2.
user_prompt: Perform Bader charge analysis on bulk rutile TiO2 (rutile structure, P4_2/mnm). Report the Bader net charge (in electrons) for Ti atoms and O atoms.

references: Koch & Manzhos, J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 8, 1593 (2017)
method.modeling: Conventional tetragonal rutile cell (P4_2/mnm), 2 TiO2 formula units; octahedrally 6-coordinated Ti, trigonally 3-coordinated O; relax the internal oxygen u parameter.
method.rationale: Bader values from Koch & Manzhos 2017 (all-electron PBE rutile): Ti +2.52 e, O ~ -1.3 e. Clean rutile is a closed-shell d0 Ti4+ insulator and needs no +U.
